spend_daily.focus: Teaser video for the biggest sale of the year, early access and WhatsApp sign up ads, build video viewer and engager audiences, bestseller catalogue warm up
Same as above, test 3 to 4 hooks so peak days only run proven creatives
Teaser and early access sign ups, bestseller catalogue on
Sneak peek of new season styles and the BFS collection, reels and UGC
Sneak peek continues, grow viewer and site visitor audiences
Wishlist and save the date messaging, WhatsApp opt in push
Countdown statics, reminder ads to engagers and site visitors
Countdown, what to expect, up to 60% off and bestsellers at minimum discount
Sale goes live at midnight, reminder to all warm audiences, day 1 campaigns approved and scheduled for 12 am

Black Friday launch. 60% of spend on retargeting past buyers, site visitors, engagers and the WhatsApp list with up to 60% off statics. Advantage plus catalogue for new audiences. Check pacing at 10 am, 2 pm and 6 pm
Weekend push with category hero ads for kurtas, suit sets and dresses, product ads for cart abandoners, UGC reels
Sunday, bestsellers in stock plus complete the look bottom at 1,099 or 1,299
Scale the best ad sets from the weekend, pause sets below minimum ROAS, cart offer creatives with extra 5% and 10%
New creatives to avoid fatigue, meme reels, founder and store videos, broad audiences and lookalikes of BFS buyers
Rotate categories to short tops, co ords and dresses, bottoms 2 for 2,199 and 3 for 2,999
New styles added message on the deep discount range, retarget people who visited but did not buy
Friday, free bottom above 7,999 to push order value
Last 48 hours, countdown and low stock messages
Last day, highest closing spend, retarget everyone who added to cart or viewed products in the last 7 days
Sale ends in the morning, switch sale ads off at close and go back to BAU

Typo statics, meme reels, partnerships, all-sale catalogue; broad audiences
